rules i follow so i never
run out of things to say

ask what they're excited about

i ask people what they're really looking forward to this month. it's the easiest way into a warm conversation that people genuinely enjoy having with you.

notice something real

i notice one real detail, like a book they carry or a song they hum, and ask about it. specific questions start better conversations than generic ones.

share small stories

i keep a few short, funny stories from my week ready to tell. a good little story is the fastest way to turn boring small talk into real conversation.

learn something daily

i learn one fascinating thing every day in 5 minutes: octopuses, ancient rome, black holes. one good fact is enough to bring any dying conversation back to life.

let silences breathe

i let short pauses happen without panicking. a calm silence gives both people a moment to think, and the next thing said is usually better than the last.
